title: feat(plugin-chatbot): a record link in an assistant answer opens the record in the console (objectui#13037)
body:
Fixes #13037
Clause-②: no

## What this does

An assistant answer can now link a record so that a click opens that record's console page, in the same tab, with no external-link dialog. Every other link keeps streamdown's link-safety dialog and new tab.

### The record-link form (for cloud's `data_explorer` rule line)

- Form: `/record/OBJECT/ID`, written in markdown as `[Wayne Enterprises](/record/account/acc_42)`.
- Grammar (`RECORD_LINK_PATTERN` in `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/recordLink.ts`), matched against the whole href:

```text
^\/record\/([a-z_][a-z0-9_]*)\/([A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128})$
```

- OBJECT is the spec's object-name grammar (`^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*$`). ID is 1 to 128 letters, digits, `_` or `-`.
- A query string, a fragment, an encoded slash, a trailing slash or any further path segment fails the match. Such a link is not navigated and nothing is passed to the host; it stays a default safe link (dialog plus new tab).
- `./record/OBJECT/ID` reaches the click as the same form, because rehype-harden rewrites it to `/record/...`. A bare `record/OBJECT/ID` is dropped by rehype-harden and renders as text.
- The agent writes no mount and no package id. The host resolves both.

### How it works

- Premise checked first: streamdown@2.5.0's default link component, which carries the dialog, is not exported. Overriding `components.a` would therefore replace link handling for every link. The interception uses streamdown's own `linkSafety.onLinkCheck` instead, and only for the record form. For every other href it returns the caller's check, or `false` when there is none, so streamdown opens its dialog exactly as before.
- On a record-form click, `onLinkCheck` hands `{ objectName, recordId }` to the host. It then returns a promise that never settles. streamdown awaits that check and on `true` opens a new tab, on anything else the dialog. A record link wants neither, so the click ends there. Each click gets a fresh promise, so nothing accumulates.
- The host opener is the chat's existing `onOpenRecord`, the same handler the `open_record` card calls (`openRecord` in `AiChatPage.tsx`). It resolves the app segment from the object's owning package and calls the router's `navigate`, so the router basename (`/_console/` or root) applies. There is no second copy of that resolution.
- `ChatbotEnhanced` supplies `onOpenRecord` to the answer's `MessageResponse` through a module-private context (`RecordLinkContext`). A context change reaches the answer even though `MessageResponse` is memoised on `children` and `isAnimating`. When the host gives no `onOpenRecord`, the context is `null` and the `linkSafety` config is passed through unchanged.
- No new export: `recordLink.ts` is imported by `elements/message.tsx` and `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` only. It sits outside `elements/`, which holds vendored upstream files only (pinned by `the vendored directory stays vendored` in `spec-symbol-batch6.test.ts`). No prop, type member or i18n key was added.

## Tests

- `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/chatRecordLink-13037.test.tsx` uses the real `ChatbotEnhanced` and streamdown:
  - (a) A record link calls `onOpenRecord({ objectName, recordId })` with no dialog and no `window.open`. The `./record/...` spelling does the same.
  - (b) An external link and a same-origin `/apps/crm/account` link in the same answer both open the link-safety dialog, showing their url, and the host is not called.
  - (c) `?tab=related`, `#notes` and `/edit` variants open the dialog and are never handed to the host.
  - (d) CONTROL: with no host opener, the record form keeps the dialog. A plain markdown answer renders with no links.
  - The grammar unit pins accepted and rejected hrefs.
- `packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/AiChatPage.recordLink-13037.test.tsx` uses the real `ChatPane` and `ChatbotEnhanced` in a `BrowserRouter`. Clicking the link lands `window.location.pathname` on `/_console/apps/com.acme.crm/account/record/acc_42` with basename `/_console`, and on `/apps/com.acme.crm/account/record/acc_42` with basename `/`. No dialog opens and `window.open` is not called.

### Ablations

Each ablation used `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which proves the mutation on disk and proves the restore by blob hash against `HEAD`, with `git diff HEAD` empty. They ran at `a677efb104`. The later commit only moved the helper file, with the logic byte-identical.

- Interception removed (`withRecordLinks(linkSafety, openRecordLink)` replaced by plain `linkSafety`): 4 tests fail, both (a) cases and both basename cases. The first attempt was refused by the tool before running, because the replacement text was not unique, so it was a no-op. It was re-run with a unique marker.
- Strict end anchor removed from the pattern: the grammar unit and (c) fail.
- Non-record links answered `true` instead of the default: (b) and (c) fail.
- Every restore returned the HEAD blob (`3204883137ed` for `message.tsx`, `cfabaf48ce6d` for the helper).

### Gates (local, at `9fd11fbd7e`)

- Closure build `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/app-shell^...`: 28/28 tasks.
- `type-check` for `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` and `@object-ui/app-shell`: exit 0. The new test files are in the `tsconfig.test.json` file list.
- `vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/` plus the app-shell test: 78 files, 769 tests passed.
- The full `packages/app-shell/` directory is left to CI.
- The full pre-tsc battery, plus `check:new-line-citations`, `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask`, `check-changeset-fixed` and `check-changeset-presence`: all exit 0.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the 5 changed files: 0 errors. There are 15 warnings, all on lines this PR does not touch. Type-aware linting is not enabled, so the diff cannot move any untouched file's result.

## Acceptance notes

- Only the full-page console chat (`AiChatPage` / `ChatPane`) passes `onOpenRecord` today. A `ChatbotEnhanced` host without it, such as the floating chatbot, keeps the default dialog for the record form, which then opens `/record/...` in a new tab where nothing serves it. That is the same behaviour every link has there today. Carrier: none.
- Cloud's rule line on objectstack-ai/cloud#3072 can name the form and the regex above once this is in cloud's `.objectui-sha`.

Changeset: `.changeset/13037-chat-record-link.md` (`@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` patch). The app-shell change is test-only.
